set.body:
Stage 5 of the post-closeout Panama plan.

Keep java.lang.foreign out of Ravel core and retain primitive JVM arrays as Ravel storage. Do not add FFM downcalls for elementwise add/sum microkernels or use Linker critical heap access for long-running numerical kernels. After Ravel's public kernel/build/indexing contracts are stable and Gale has a concrete native BLAS/LAPACK need, evaluate FFM in an optional Gale JVM-native or BLAS backend where the ABI boundary, native memory ownership, copy costs, callbacks, error handling, and JDK requirements can be explicit.

Done means a Gale-side design/benchmark decision with end-to-end copy-inclusive evidence. This bead does not authorize BLAS, matrix multiplication, native storage, or an FFM dependency in Ravel.
set.title: Evaluate FFM only at the Gale native backend boundary
